messages:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding emberstone-13b (decoder-only). Early smoke shows KV-cache behavior that doesn't match our RoPE/KV assumptions. Opening intake thread.

arjun: Where are you seeing the mismatch? paste the minimal log if you have it.

maya: Pasted snippet below — seen on ded-1 during autoreg replay at past_len=1024:
```
ERROR kv_store: kv_index mismatch at step=4 expected=34 got=36
trace: AttentionRoPE.apply -> kv_store.write
config: rotary_base=10000, rope_mod=false
```

sam: Emberstone arch ok? Is it interleaved attention or standard fused layout? If rotary params differ we get phase shifts.

lia: Quick intake checklist (first pass):
- reproduce with kv-replay (past=256/512/1024)
- kv-prefix-consistency test (replay vs incremental)
- rope-phase-shift diagnostics (plot phase over token index)
- attention-mode detection (gpt-native vs flash-attn)
- quant-route smoke (fp16 -> int8)
- add config flag `accepts_rope_mod` to model metadata

maya: Repro command I used: `python -m redwood.replay --model emberstone-13b --mode autoreg --past 1024 --seed 42` — consistently fails at >512. Uploading logs now.

runtime-bot: scheduled job #482 created: emberstone-compat-quick (queue:ded-1) — ETA 1771234780.

arjun: Priority: block hosted promotion until we validate KV/rope stability. Assigning triage: @arjun @sam @lia.

sam: I'll run kernel traces and check whether kernel selection (flash vs mm) + kv layout differs for sequence lengths >512. Also run quantized 8-bit path to see if index math folded incorrectly.

lia: If it's a RoPE offset/param mismatch, we should add a runtime compatibility heuristic: detect `rotary_base` delta and auto-emit a compat-variant (with rebase) before promoting. Add to onboarding checklist too.

maya: Uploading repro bundle to s3: s3://redwood-onboard/emberstone/repro-1771234567.tar.gz and linking to triage card.

sam: quick note — if repro shows kv_index off-by-2, check KV write alignment when using continuous-batching. We've seen batching boundary bugs cause exactly that.

lia: TL;DR action items: reproduce, kernel trace, rope-param check, quant smoke, add metadata flag + runtime fallback. Will document in onboarding doc.

maya: Thanks — I'll update the intake card and add failing trace snippets. :thumbsup:

runtime-bot: job #482 completed (success/fail TBD)
